title: Positive-tolerance exclusion and the minimum feasible representation cost
scope: A constructed repeated-episode forecasting experiment for the general representation theorem, not an empirical KAHM comparison
episode: (Z,S,Y), with S Bernoulli(0.2) and independent Rademacher Z,R,N; Y=0.8*S*Z+0.1*N in repairable, Y=0.8*S*R+0.1*N in irreducible
cost_meaning: number of retained scalar feature coordinates, not runtime
decoder: BlockBoundedRidge, unpenalized intercept, alpha=0, common sum-of-block-Frobenius-norms budget, prediction clipping to target bounds
stream_rule: base=100000000*regime_index+100*repetition_seed, regime_index=0 for repairable and 1 for irreducible; train=base+11, validation=base+23, calibration=base+47
stratum_pairing: in original episode order, disjoint consecutive pairs within each frozen history-only stratum; discard one odd observation per stratum
stratum_mass: estimated from calibration with simultaneous Hoeffding intervals intersected with the probability simplex
confidence_scope: all five calibration sizes, all three retained prefixes, all upper endpoints, unconditional lower endpoints, and both stratified lower families within one regime and repetition; not joint across repetitions or regimes
stratified_total_delta: eta=0.02/(3*2*5) per partition, prefix and size; eta/2 for stratum masses and eta/(2*S_partition) for each conditional pair lower endpoint
rare_strata_policy: lower endpoint zero if fewer than two disjoint pairs
primary_lower: maximum of the two separately budgeted estimated-mass stratified lower endpoints
comparators: validation-only cheapest fitted predictor below the empirical MSE tolerance
upper-only cheapest fitted predictor whose upper endpoint passes
same upper selection with unconditional class lower endpoints
same upper selection with stratified class lower endpoints
cost_interval: c_low=min retained cost with lower<=tolerance^2; c_up=min retained cost with upper<=tolerance^2; empty minima are infinity. Equal finite endpoints certify the minimum class cost; all class lower endpoints above tolerance certify infeasibility.
oracle_use: for coverage and tightness assessment only, never used in empirical confidence endpoints or model selection
reporting: retain every repetition, every sample-size point, inconclusive and adverse outcomes, coefficient arrays, calibration state indices, confidence sufficient statistics, source hashes and failures; no optional stopping or post-calibration design adjustment
